hero.label: Membership
hero.headline: Institutional Membership
hero.subheadline: Joining Gyanteerth as a member institution connects your school or educational organisation to a national network of academic excellence — and opens access to the Society's full range of programmes, resources, and recognition platforms.

body.text: Gyanteerth institutional membership is designed for schools and educational organisations that are committed to academic quality, professional development, and the advancement of education in India. Membership is the gateway to the Society's complete portfolio of academic programmes, competitions, educator development initiatives, and national recognition frameworks.

Member institutions become part of a national community of practice — sharing knowledge, best practices, and resources with peer institutions across India, and contributing to the collective advancement of Indian education.

categories.label: Membership Categories
categories.heading: Membership Categories
categories.intro: Gyanteerth offers membership categories designed to suit the full range of educational institutions and organisations.

items.title: Institutional Member
items.subtitle: For individual schools and educational institutions
items.description: Open to any registered school or educational institution — primary, secondary, or senior secondary — affiliated to any recognised board or operating under state government recognition. Institutional membership provides full access to all Gyanteerth programmes, competitions, and resources.

eligibility.text: Affiliated to a recognised board or state government recognised
Commitment to Gyanteerth's academic and ethical standards

items.title: Organisational Member
items.subtitle: For educational trusts, societies, and foundations
items.description: Open to registered educational trusts, societies, and foundations operating one or more educational institutions. Organisational membership covers the trust or society as a whole, with benefits extending to all institutions under its umbrella.

eligibility.text: Registered educational trust, society, or foundation
Operating one or more recognised educational institutions
Commitment to Gyanteerth's academic and ethical standards

items.title: Associate Member
items.subtitle: For educational groups, networks, and allied organisations
items.description: Open to multi-campus educational groups, school chains, and allied educational organisations that wish to engage with Gyanteerth's network and programmes without full institutional membership. Associate membership provides access to selected programmes and network activities.

eligibility.text: Multi-campus educational group, school chain, or allied educational organisation

items.title: Life Member
items.subtitle: For institutions seeking permanent affiliation
items.description: Life membership is available to institutions that have been Institutional Members in good standing for a minimum of three consecutive years and wish to establish a permanent affiliation with the Society. Life members enjoy all the benefits of Institutional Membership on a permanent basis.

eligibility.text: Institutional Member in good standing for a minimum of three consecutive years
Payment of the prescribed life membership fee

items.title: Access to All Academic Programmes
items.description: Full access to Gyanteerth's complete portfolio of olympiads, inter-school championships, science exhibitions, and academic competitions.

items.title: Educator Development Programmes
items.description: Priority access to the National Teachers' Conclave, Teaching Excellence Awards, School Leadership Development Programme, and subject-specific workshops.

items.title: National Recognition Platforms
items.description: Eligibility for the National School Excellence Awards, National Academic Merit Certificates, and Gyanteerth Institutional Accreditation.

items.title: Institutional Network Access
items.description: Membership of Gyanteerth's national institutional network — with access to peer institutions, best practice exchange, and collaborative programmes.

items.title: Governance Participation
items.description: Voting rights at the General Body and eligibility to nominate representatives for the Society's governance bodies.

items.title: Official Membership Certificate
items.description: An official Gyanteerth Institutional Membership Certificate, suitable for display and use in institutional communications.

items.title: Publications & Resources
items.description: Access to Gyanteerth's publications, academic resources, and research outputs.

items.title: Dedicated Support
items.description: A dedicated point of contact within the Society's regional coordination team for all programme and membership queries.

steps.title: Submit an Enquiry
steps.description: Complete the membership enquiry form below. Our team will review your enquiry and respond within five working days with full application details.

steps.title: Application Review
steps.description: The Society's Membership & Institutional Relations Committee reviews all applications against the eligibility criteria for the relevant membership category.

steps.title: Approval & Onboarding
steps.description: Upon approval by the Executive Committee, the institution receives its official membership certificate and is onboarded to the Society's programmes and network.

steps.title: Annual Renewal
steps.description: Institutional membership is renewed annually. The Society's team will contact member institutions in advance of the renewal date with full details.
